figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_cents) paid FROM payments WHERE status='settled' AND payment_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_id), b AS (SELECT i.order_id,SUM(r.refund_cents) refunded FROM returns r JOIN order_items i ON i.order_item_id=r.order_item_id WHERE r.return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.order_id) SELECT o.order_id,o.net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0) cash_net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)-o.net_cents difference_cents FROM v_order_net o LEFT JOIN a ON a.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)<>o.net_cents ORDER BY difference_cents DESC
